bivalves text index | photo index Phylum Mollusca

Class Bivalvia > Family Veneridae Discrepant venus clam
Gafrarium dispar*Family Veneridaeupdated Nov 11

Where seen? This clam is sometimes seen on sandy shores. Elsewhere, they are found on intertidal shores with sand.

Features: About 4-6cm. Shell thick with fine ribs and usually a pattern of fine broken lines.


Tuas, May 05

*Species are difficult to positively identify without close examination.
On this website, they are grouped by external features for convenience of display.
